scenario: LLOG.4.2 negation-justified retraction must fire for a fact emitted by a rule AFTER the guarded token already exists. `block_input` emits `Blocked{C}` while `no Product where name == c.product` holds; once `produce` emits the matching `Product{foo.o}` in a later pump, the negation must retract `Blocked{C}` so `ready(C)`/`fetch_key(C)` schedule. A not_right_activate that consults a right-fact index populated only from the left side misses a late-arriving fact once that index is allocated by an unrelated earlier join (the source `Product{foo.c}` joining `Consumes{P}`). The `fetch_key` rule logs `key` on each firing; it fires once for P (pump1) and — only if the unblock works — once for C (pump2).
rules_ds:
schema Product scope logical:
    name: String key
    pathname: String mutable
    digest: String mutable
schema Step scope logical:
    id: String key
    tool: String mutable
    argv: String mutable
schema Output scope logical:
    name: String key
    step: String mutable
    pathname: String mutable
schema Consumes scope logical:
    step: String key
    product: String key
schema Blocked scope logical:
    step: String key
schema Ready scope logical:
    step: String key
schema ActionKey scope logical:
    step: String key
    action_key: String mutable
schema Dispatched scope logical:
    step: String key
schema StepOutput scope logical:
    name: String key
    step: String mutable
    pathname: String mutable
    digest: String mutable
service cache.key:
    kwarg step: String
    no response
service exec.run:
    kwarg step: String
    kwarg argv: String
    no response
rule block_input:
    Consumes c
    no Product p where p.name == c.product
->
    emit Blocked logical step: c.step
rule ready:
    Step s
    no Blocked b where b.step == s.id
->
    emit Ready logical step: s.id
rule fetch_key:
    Ready r
    no ActionKey k where k.step == r.step
->
    call cache.key step: r.step nocooldown
    log critical "key"
rule run:
    ActionKey k
    no Dispatched d where d.step == k.step
    Step s where s.id == k.step
->
    call exec.run step: s.id argv: s.argv nocooldown
rule produce:
    ActionKey k
    StepOutput so where so.step == k.step
->
    emit Product logical name: so.name pathname: so.pathname digest: so.digest
